title: Cyberpunk Ninja
premise: Kanshi Dynamics owns the Kanshi Spire and everything below it. Its CEO, the Daimyo, is building an army of super soldiers by tearing the soul out of the city's people and throwing it away. Without a soul, a body obeys and doesn't complain when its parts are replaced with cybernetic enhancements. Kuro, the Daimyo's bodyguard and the Academy's master instructor, found out and turned on him. The Daimyo split him in two: his body became Mukuro, the obedient captain of the hollowed guard, and his soul was thrown down the Spire like everyone else's. Discarded souls fade within minutes. Kuro's did not. Tethered to life by rage and missing most of his memories, it fell into the Sump Scrapyard and woke a scrapped Kanshi robot: Hotaru. Hotaru believes she is a living person who lost her memories. Kuro only knows that someone at the top of the Spire killed him. They climb together, him for revenge and her for answers, while the hollowed army prepares to march on the rest of the city.

lore.soul_and_mind: A soul is what keeps a body alive and wanting things. A mind is memory and personality. Kuro's mind rides on his soul. Hotaru's mind grew on that same soul after it woke her frame. One soul can keep only one body alive for long.
lore.kuro_memories: When Kuro was split, his memories tore three ways. Some came with his soul: how to fight, and how the city and Kanshi work. Those memories are where Hotaru's skills come from. Some broke off as Memory Shards. The rest stayed in his body, Mukuro.
lore.hollowing: The Daimyo's extraction tears the soul out of a person. The body lives, obeys, and remembers how to fight, but wants nothing. The soul is vented out of the Spire and fades. Hollowing cannot be undone.
lore.the_army: Most of the city is still free. The hollowed soldiers, drilled at the Academy and mustered in the Tenshu, are about to march on the city to capture and hollow everyone else.
lore.hotaru_frame: HTR-0 'HOTARU' was a prototype from Kanshi's first super-soldier program: robot Shinobi frames with phase drives. They were scrapped because a machine without a soul cannot improvise. The Daimyo switched to hollowing people. Kuro's soul is what made the frame work, and the fighting memories that came with it are where her skills come from. Her name is the model name stamped on her chassis.
lore.memory_shards: Pieces of Kuro's memory that broke off when he was split from his body; the rest stayed in Mukuro. They scattered down the Spire as his soul fell, so one waits in every area.
lore.the_pipeline: Big Oni sells Sump residents to Kanshi. Lady Luck sends up debtors who lose everything. Kanshi's factories poison the Sump, and its Physic Gardens sell the cure at a huge markup. The Kanshi Line monorail has no Sump stops. Every road leads to the Academy, where people are hollowed.

cast.Hotaru: Scrapped prototype frame HTR-0, woken by Kuro's soul. Dry, guarded, and certain she is a person. Her scarf shows her Phase Step charges. The game's central question is whether she is alive. She is.
cast.Kuro: The soul of the Daimyo's former bodyguard, with only some of his memories: how to fight and how the city works, but almost nothing of his own life. Sardonic, driven by rage, and slowly remembering who he was. He appears as a violet glitch at the edge of Hotaru's visor.
cast.Mukuro: Kuro's body, hollowed. Captain of the Daimyo's guard and the Academy's enforcer. He has Kuro's skill and the memories that stayed in the body, and none of his soul.
cast.Tetsu: A one-armed ramen cook in the Sump and Kuro's oldest friend. He lost his arm when a Kanshi drone malfunctioned; Kanshi covered it up, and he's been digging into the company ever since. He treats Hotaru as a stranger, but some of her habits remind him of someone.
cast.DaiCam: A Sump livestreamer climbing the Spire for views. Comic relief who keeps getting into trouble, until his stream becomes the city's warning.
cast.Big Oni: Boss of the Hannya Boys. Kanshi pays him to keep the Sump penned in and to sell its people.
cast.Dobunushi: 'Lord of the ditch.' A mass of mutants fused around a broken Kanshi outflow pipe in the Sewers.
cast.Lady Luck: Croupier who runs the Pachinko Vaults. Kanshi pays her to keep the city gambling, broke, and distracted, and per head for the debtors she sends up.
cast.The Harmacist: Head of Kanshi's Physic Gardens. She sells the Sump the cure for the sickness Kanshi's factories cause, at whatever price it will bear.
cast.The Daimyo: CEO of Kanshi Dynamics. A human man in a samurai exoskeleton who believes the soul is the root of every riot, strike, and theft. He carries Tamakiri, the blade that split Kuro.

branches.description: One choice at the end of Chapter 6 decides the rest of the game. A scene whose condition is 'branch: kuro_spared' or 'branch: kuro_destroyed' plays only on that branch. 'optional' marks a scene the player can skip (Memory Shards, repeat talks); 'optional; branch: ...' means both. Scenes with no condition play on every branch.
branches.kuro_spared: Hotaru and Kuro compromise: he gets his revenge, she gets her answers, and he stops fighting her for control. In Chapter 7 Kuro realizes he can possess Mukuro, his own former body, and asks Hotaru to bring it along. At the Last Shrine he moves into it and fights beside her in the first two phases of the final battle. One soul cannot keep two bodies alive, so after the Daimyo falls Kuro lets go and leaves the whole soul to Hotaru.
branches.kuro_destroyed: Hotaru destroys Kuro's mind and keeps the soul for herself. She climbs the rest of the Spire alone, Mukuro can only be put down, and she faces the Daimyo by herself.

Big Oni.who: Gang boss of the Hannya Boys. He guards the drain that leads out of the Scrapyard.
mechanics: Slow club swings: deflect them.
Heavy Strikes (Phase Step, then attack) stagger him.
Phase 2 overhead slam is a Breach that sends a shockwave across the roof: jump it or Phase Step through.

Dobunushi.who: A mass of polluted mutants fused around a broken Kanshi outflow pipe.
mechanics: Sludge rises in waves from the bottom of the arena: stay on the platforms while the tide is high.
Its arms slam down onto platforms: deflect the slam, then cut the arm. Each arm has its own Stance bar.
With both arms cut, its core opens: strike it until the arms regrow.
Phase 2 toxic spew is a Breach wave across the floor: jump it or Phase Step through.

Lady Luck.who: Croupier who runs every table on the Vaults tier.
mechanics: A slot machine behind her picks each attack, and names it when the reels stop (CARD FAN!, SHOCKWAVE!, LASERS!...).
Deflect her card-blades to send them back.
SHOCKWAVE is a Breach: jump or Phase Step. Jackpot turns on laser grids: Phase Step through them.

The Harmacist.who: Head of the Physic Gardens, armed with a vial bandolier and a stim injector.
mechanics: Throws vials in arcs: deflect them back at her.
Poison clouds linger where vials break: they sting (damage without staggering), so leave the cloud or Phase Step through it.
When she pulls out a stim to heal, interrupt her with a Heavy Strike.
Phase 2: she injects herself, gets faster, and her poison cloud burst becomes a Breach.
Defeated, she kneels and pleads her case, then limps out of the Apothecary once Hotaru answers.

Raijin.who: The Kanshi Line's enforcement locomotive, built to ram anyone on the tracks who doesn't belong.
mechanics: Its reactor core is shuttered except while it vents steam: strike it then.
Deflect its cannon shells straight back into the core.
Deflect or jump the pantograph arm; step off roof sections that spark before they go live.
Phase 2: when the horn sounds, jump the plow it drags across the roof.

Kuro.who: Kuro's mind, fighting Hotaru for control of the frame inside the space they share.
mechanics: Uses Hotaru's own moves: the 4-hit string, blink strikes from behind, and a Breach Phase Cut.
When he Phase Cuts at you, Phase Step through him at the same moment to Clash, which breaks his Stance.
Possession: when the screen edges turn purple, left and right are swapped.
When his last segment breaks he kneels: press E to reach out and compromise, or attack to destroy his mind. This choice sets the branch for the rest of the game.

Mukuro.who: Kuro's hollowed body. Captain of the Daimyo's guard.
mechanics: A duelist who guards everything except right after his own combos.
Deflect each strike to build his Stance, then punish openings with two or three hits; greed gets countered.
Holds strikes to bait early deflects.
Phase 2 adds a kunai fan, a diving slam that sends shockwaves along the floor (jump them), and a shadow that strikes from behind.

The Daimyo.who: Kanshi's CEO, in his samurai exoskeleton and then in person.

forms.name: Samurai exoskeleton
forms.mechanics: Deflect the iaido draw and 3-slash nodachi strings, jump the stomp shockwaves, Phase Step through the thruster charge, and strike while the armor recovers.
forms.ally: kuro_spared: Kuro (in Mukuro's body) fights like Hotaru: he flanks the armor, deflects, Phase Steps Breaches, cuts into its openings and Heavy Strikes its guard. He has 4 hidden HP and gets back up once per Memory Shard collected (a shard burns above him).

forms.name: Castle defenses
forms.mechanics: The damaged exoskeleton plugs into the Tenshu. Turrets fire bullet barrages: deflect them back into the exoskeleton and strike when it drops to recharge.
forms.ally: kuro_spared: Kuro keeps fighting (every other turret volley targets him; he deflects most of it back into the armor) until the end of this phase, then collapses.

forms.name: The Daimyo, in person
forms.mechanics: The armor crashes to the floor and stays there, going dark, as he steps out to duel with Tamakiri. Iaido dash-cuts, feints, 3-cut strings, two long parry strings (a 7-cut rhythm, and a 5-cut string where he blinks behind Hotaru between cuts; deflecting the heavy last cut staggers him), and a soul-grab Breach that fills Hotaru's Stance if it connects: Phase Step through it. He flashes white before every cut.

core_combat: Attack chains into a 4-hit combo; Up + attack is a rising Launcher.
Phase Step (Space): an invincible, aimable dash with 2 charges (shown by the scarf color). Passes through lasers and attacks; refills on landing or a perfect deflect.
Heavy Strike: attack during or right after a Phase Step. Breaks guards and builds a lot of enemy Stance.
Deflect: press Down right before a hit lands (enemies flash white just before). A perfect deflect builds the attacker's Stance. Holding Down blocks, but blocking builds Hotaru's Stance.

Stance: every fighter has a Stance bar, Hotaru included. It starts empty and fills gold under pressure, then slowly settles. When an enemy's Stance fills and breaks, a red reticle appears: attack near it to perform an Execution (instant kill for regular enemies, a whole health segment for bosses). Every Execution also refills one gourd charge and clears Hotaru's Stance. When Hotaru's Stance breaks, she overheats and staggers.
Breach: a red diamond marks an attack that cannot be blocked or deflected. Phase Step through it or jump it.
survival: Nano-Gourd (R) heals; upgraded to 4 charges after Big Oni.
Shrine Terminals (hacked vending machines, E) heal, refill the gourd and set the respawn point.
traversal: Wall cling and wall jump; jump up through thin platforms, double-tap Down (or Phase Step down) to drop through.
Lifts: the Scrapyard lift cycles up and down; the Spire Lift carries Hotaru from Mukuro's Ring up into the Tenshu.
Toxic pools and rising sludge tides (Sewers). Each room starts at low tide; a TIDE RISING warning flashes and the pumps gurgle before each rise.
Laser grids pulse on and off (Vaults, Castle).
Greenhouse heat vents carry you upward; some vents pulse (Physic Gardens).
Headwind, bottomless gaps between cars, and Kanshi patrol crows skimming the roofs (Monorail).
Phasing blocks: two sets alternate being solid every few seconds; the incoming set lights up and turns solid just before the other vanishes (Hollow Floor, Academy).
Possession: Kuro periodically swaps left and right (Hollow Floor).
enemies: Drainlings: irradiated zombies covered in glowing pustules who lunge and spit sludge (Sewers).
Croupier dealers who throw card-blades, and slot turrets (Pachinko Vaults).
Garden Wardens: guarded duelists you must deflect to break, and sprayer drones (Physic Gardens).
Memory echoes of Kuro's past fights (Hollow Floor).
Hollowed trainees: Kuro's former students, who dash in and throw kunai (Academy).
Hollowed soldiers, castle turrets, beams, and lasers (Tenshu).
mechanics.collectibles: Nine hidden Memory Shards, one per area. Each is a piece of Kuro's memory that broke off when he was split from his body.

chapters.label: Prologue
chapters.title: Sump Scrapyard
chapters.summary: A scrapped Kanshi robot wakes up in the Scrapyard with a soul that isn't supposed to exist. Hotaru believes she's a person who lost her memories. Kuro, the voice in her head, only knows that someone at the top of the Spire killed him. Tetsu the ramen cook has never met her, but one of her habits stops him cold.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: KANSHI DYNAMICS // HTR-0. Shinobi frame, prototype. Status: SCRAPPED.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Pilot: NONE. ...Pilot: DETECTED. Source: UNKNOWN. Motor control: OK. Memory index: NOT FOUND.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Rain. Cold. Scrap metal everywhere. Where am I?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: My name is Hotaru. I know that much. Everything before tonight is static.
Good. You're awake. Try not to die before I figure out whose body this is.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...What?
Never mind. Get up before the drones find you.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Who said that? There's no one here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Not out there. In here. I don't know how I got in, so don't ask.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And the purple ghost flickering at the edge of my visor?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Also me. Call me Kuro. I remember how to fight. I remember how this city works.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: My own life? Almost nothing. Except one thing.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Which is?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Somebody at the top of that tower killed me. And I'm going to return the favor.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're dead? You're talking to me.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Dead men talk, apparently. What about you? What's a girl doing in a scrapyard full of chrome?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm a person. Somebody rebuilt me with chrome and dumped me here. That's all.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Then whoever did it is up there too. The Kanshi Spire. Sump to sky, Kanshi owns it all.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You want your answers, I want my killer. Same direction. Up it is.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Scavenger drones. They strip anything that stops moving.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: So don't stop moving. Cut them down before they dive.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Wall turret. You can't reach it from here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Catch the round on your blade at the last instant and send it home.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: How do you know how to do that?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: No idea. My hands remember. Well, your hands.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Kanshi laser fence. Solid to meat. But you're not all meat, are you?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm human.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Sure. Phase through it anyway.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Well, look what the storm dragged in. Haven't seen you around here.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I just woke up in your scrapyard.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Ha. Everybody wakes up in the scrapyard eventually. Sit. Eat something. On the house.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Hotaru taps her chopsticks twice on the rim of the bowl before she eats.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Nothing. Knew a kid who did that. Long time ago.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: That vending machine's a Shrine. Hacked it myself. Rest there and it'll fix you up and fill that gourd of yours.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Nice old man. He's hiding something.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: So are you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I'm hiding nothing. I have nothing to hide. That's my whole problem.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: You're heading up? Then you go through Neon Alley, and Neon Alley belongs to the Hannya Boys.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Kanshi pays them to keep us down here. Nobody leaves the Scrapyard unless they're sold.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: And kid... come back and eat something when you're done.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...A courtyard. Rain on a tiled roof. Someone is teaching me to hold a blade.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: A woman. She's laughing at me.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: That's your memory?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Must be. It broke off of me somewhere. I want the rest back.

scenes.trigger: Reach the edge of the Scrapyard

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Neon Alley. Past those masks is the only drain out of the Scrapyard.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And past the drain?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Up. Until somebody tells us the truth.

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: Neon Alley
chapters.summary: The Hannya Boys keep the Sump penned into the Scrapyard and sell its people to Kanshi. Hotaru meets DaiCam the livestreamer and executes Big Oni, who was guarding the only way out: the drain into the Sewers.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Neon Alley. The Hannya Boys run these floors. Oni masks, steel pipes, bad manners.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Tetsu said they sell people.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: To Kanshi. By the head. They'll try to sell you too.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: They'll move.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Ha. My thoughts exactly.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: See the bar over his head? That's his Stance. You have one too.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Deflect his swings and hit him hard. When his Stance breaks, a reticle shows. Click it to execute him.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Okay chat, okay, this is fine. This is content.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Guys? Guys, I'm not for sale! I have a very large audience! People would notice!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Let's give him something to film.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, we have a NINJA. Say hi to the chat.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Okay, she's not saying hi. Chat, she's walking away.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Get off this floor. They were going to sell you.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: To who? Who buys a streamer? Actually, don't answer that. Smash that follow, ninja lady!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That one's got a red diamond over him. That's a Breach.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You can't block it and you can't deflect it. Phase Step straight through him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Three of them, and they've locked the doors. Use the platforms. Don't get surrounded.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 2 (behind a breakable ceiling in the Ambush room)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...A rooftop in the Sump. Rain. A big guy laughing next to me, sharing noodles.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Two arms, back then. He called me 'kid'.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: That's the ramen man. Tetsu.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Huh. So that's why he looked at you like that.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Big one up ahead, sitting on the drain cover. Slow, though.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: When he lifts that club over his head, you hit him hard or you get out of the way.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Hit him hard. Got it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Rest at the Shrine first. I'd hate to lose this body. I'm just getting used to it.

lines.speaker: Big Oni
lines.text: A runaway from the Scrapyard? Kanshi pays double for the ones with chrome.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That's the gang boss. Big Oni. Deflect the club swings.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Heavy Strikes stagger him: Phase Step, then attack. Break his Stance and execute him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He's angry now. Watch the overhead slam. It's a Breach, and it shakes the whole roof.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Jump the shockwave or phase through it.

lines.speaker: Big Oni
lines.text: Kanshi... pays on time... What did I care where they went...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He dropped something. A Kanshi ledger. Names, dates, and a price for every head.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: 'Delivered to: the Academy.'

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Academy... I know that word. I don't know why I know it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The drain he was sitting on goes under the wall. That's our way out.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: ...and CUT. Chat, did everybody clip that?! Ninja lady just took down Big Oni! We're trending!

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: The Sewers
chapters.summary: The only way out of the Scrapyard runs under it, through sewers fed by Kanshi's factories. The waste has twisted the people who live down here into Drainlings. At the outflow, a mass of them has fused into Dobunushi.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The smell. What is that?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Everything Kanshi makes, and everything it doesn't want to keep. It all ends up down here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: And everything down here ends up in the Sump's water.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Don't touch the glowing water. It eats through chrome. Probably through people faster.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Those are people. Or they were.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Sump workers. Kanshi sends them to clear the pipes, and the pipes clear them.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: There's nothing left in there to talk to. Don't let them grab you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The pumps are failing. The sludge comes up in waves. Get high and stay high.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, welcome to urban exploring. Day three. I'm not lost. I'm 'creating suspense'.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Ninja lady! Okay, chat, this is not a coincidence, this is destiny.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You followed me.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: I followed the ledger thing! Kanshi bought my neighbor! I'm doing journalism now!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Clear the nest and point him at the exit.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: The exit is that way? Chat, I was going in circles in a sewer for three days.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Thank you. Seriously. Okay, that's enough sincerity for one stream. Byeee!

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 3 (above the Pump Station, past the tide)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...The same woman. Older now. Coughing into her sleeve.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The river behind our house turned black the year the factories opened.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Your mother.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Yeah. I think so.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Something is moving behind the gate. Something big.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The outflow chamber. Everything in this sewer drains in there. Including them.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Rest first. Then we cut our way through.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: They're all stuck together. Around the pipe.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Dobunushi. Lord of the ditch. Kanshi built it one worker at a time.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Cut the arms when they slam down. When both are gone, hit what's in the middle.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: It's spewing. That wave is a Breach. Jump it or phase it!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The pipe's still running. It'll just make another one.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Then we go to whoever owns the pipe.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: There's a ladder. And light. The Pachinko Vaults.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: From the sewer straight into the casino. Even what Kanshi wastes serves them.

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The Pachinko Vaults
chapters.summary: Kanshi pays Lady Luck to keep the city gambling, broke, and distracted. When a debtor loses everything, she sends them up to the Academy. Her slot machine picks her moves, and somebody upstairs set the odds.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Pachinko Vaults. Every floor up here is a casino, and the house always wins.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Everyone's smiling. Nobody looks happy.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That's the business model.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Laser grid. It pulses on and off, and Kanshi stations dealers behind it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Wait for a gap, or Phase Step straight through it. Mid-fight, if you have to.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Slot turrets. Three card-blades at a time.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Deflect the one coming at you and it goes straight back to whoever threw it.

scenes.trigger: A line of debtors being led to a freight lift

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: ACCOUNT CLOSED. Balance: 0. Collateral: SELF. Destination: ACADEMY INTAKE.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: They're taking them upstairs. Where the ledger said.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Lose your money, lose yourself. The Academy again. Why does that word make my teeth hurt?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: High rollers' lounge. The dealers here throw from the balconies. Get up there with them.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 4 (back room above the High Rollers floor)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...A fighting pit, right here in the Vaults. I'm young. I'm winning.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: A man in a Kanshi coat is watching. He says the Daimyo's guard pays in medicine.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: For your mother.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I took the job. I think I took it for her.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, I am currently being held as collateral. I bet my stream. I lost my stream. The stream is still running.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Ninja lady! You came back for me! For the content!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I came for the elevator.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Same thing! Hit the cage! Before they send me 'up for processing,' whatever that is!

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: FREEDOM! I'm calling this episode 'Jackpot'.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Stop gambling.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: I'm not gambling, I'm investigating gambling. Totally different. Byeee!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Lady Luck runs every table on this tier. The machine behind her picks her moves.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Watch the reels. Spades, sevens, cherries... and if they land on skulls, get off the floor.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And if it hits the jackpot?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Then we find out how fast you are.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: Well, well. 'HTR-0, Hotaru.' Cute model name, sweetheart. It's stamped right on your collar.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: It's my name.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: Sure it is. Place your bet, little firefly. Everything you have.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Deal.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: Double or nothing!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Jackpot means lasers. Phase Step through them!

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: The house... doesn't... lose... Kanshi pays per head, you know. Per head...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: She said 'model name'. Kuro. What's on my collar?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Letters. Just letters. We'll look later.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Kuro.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Later. The Gardens are next.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, the ninja just broke the bank. Literally. Somebody clip the reels!

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: The Physic Gardens
chapters.summary: A real garden on the Spire's terraces where Kanshi grows medicine. The pollution from the Sewers makes the Sump sick, and the Gardens sell it the cure at a huge markup. The Harmacist sets the prices.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Grass. Trees. Clean water. Up here, the whole time.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Kanshi's Physic Gardens. Everything that grows here gets ground into pills.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Heat vents from the greenhouses. Strong enough to carry you. Step in and ride it up.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: A Garden Warden. Kanshi duelist. It'll block anything you throw at it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: So let it swing first. Deflect, break its guard, then cut.

scenes.trigger: The price board over the dispensary

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: KANSHI CLEAR // lung treatment, 30 days. Garden cost: 4 credits. Sump price: 2,400 credits.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Six hundred times the cost. For medicine for what their own sewers did.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: They poison the water, then sell the cure. And whoever can't pay...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Ends up at the Vaults. And then the Academy.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 5 (top of the pulsing vent in the Drying Lofts)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...My first pay from the Daimyo's guard. A box of Kanshi Clear, the same pills they grow here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I brought it home. The next month the price doubled.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Did she...?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: It wasn't enough. It was never going to be enough.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: This stream is brought to you by Kanshi Clear! Breathe easy, Sump! *cough* *cough*

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're coughing.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Sponsor contract says I can't. Chat says I sound terrible. Chat is right.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: They pay me in pills. Is that weird? That feels weird now that I say it out loud.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Clear the Wardens. Then tell him what the pills cost to make.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Four credits?! Chat, I've been paying two thousand four hundred! I'm canceling the sponsorship.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: ...After this month. I need the pills. That's the trick, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: That's the trick.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Apothecary's across the bridge. The woman who sets the prices works there.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: The Harmacist
lines.text: A visitor without an appointment. Let me guess. You can't afford the cure.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You charge six hundred times what it costs.

lines.speaker: The Harmacist
lines.text: I charge what a life is worth to the person living it. That's not greed, dear. That's math.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: She throws vials. Deflect them back. Stay out of the green clouds.

lines.speaker: The Harmacist
lines.text: Let's see what my best formula does for me.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: She just juiced herself. When that cloud bursts, it's a Breach. Phase through it!

lines.speaker: The Harmacist
lines.text: Burn the garden... and the Sump dies of a cough by spring... You need me...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: We'll leave the garden. Just not the prices.

scenes.trigger: After she limps out of the Apothecary

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Her ledger has the same stamp as Big Oni's. Unpaid accounts go to the Academy.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Everything goes to the Academy. And the only way up there is the Kanshi Line.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Monorail Ascent
chapters.summary: The Kanshi Line spirals up the Spire with no Sump stops, and its gates only open for Kanshi ID. Hotaru rides it anyway. The Daimyo appears for the first time, with Mukuro at his side, and recognizes Kuro. Raijin's black box finally tells both of them what they are.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: KANSHI LINE // Next stop: TIER 40. Sump stations: NONE. Kanshi ID required at all gates.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: A train that goes everywhere except where people need it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That's not an accident. It's a wall that moves. A gate at every stop to keep us out.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: But we can get around that. By force. Cut through the gate and get on the roof.

scenes.trigger: First headwind on the train roof

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Headwind. It'll shove you back toward the last car. Keep pushing forward.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: And mind the gaps. If you slip, the couplers below can catch you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Kanshi patrol crows. They skim the roofs, fast and low. Watch for the warning on your right.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Jump them, Phase Step through them, or stand on something tall.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The track splits. The upper line climbs higher up the tower.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Up it is. There's a maintenance door in the tower wall too, if you're curious.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 6 (behind the Spiral Junction's tower door)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...My first ride on this line. Guard uniform. Kanshi ID on a lanyard.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I watched the Sump get smaller out the window. Tetsu didn't come to see me off.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Were you angry?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: No. I think I was ashamed.

scenes.trigger: DaiCam in the dining car with Kanshi guards

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Hotaru! First class! I bought a ticket with sponsor money! They have little towels!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're in a car full of Kanshi guards.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Yes, and they scanned my ID, saw 'Sump,' and would like me to leave. At speed.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: My ticket did not cover being saved by a ninja. Or getting thrown off a train.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: I'm getting off at the next stop. Wherever they'll let me. Stay safe! Like and subscribe!

scenes.trigger: A broadcast fills every screen in the car

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Every screen just changed. A man in samurai armor. And someone standing behind him.
A scrapped HTR frame riding my line. Walking, fighting. That shouldn't be possible.
Unless... that stance. Kuro. I threw you out with the rest.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...You know me.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: I made you. Then I unmade you. You should have faded like everyone else.
Shall I collect them, my lord?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The one behind him. He has your voice, Kuro. Your exact voice.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I... why does looking at him hurt?

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Raijin will collect you both. Mukuro, with me.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Raijin keeps my line clean. It does not stop for strays.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The core on its nose is shuttered. Wait for it to vent, then hit it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Deflect its shells and they fly right back into it.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Kuro was my finest guard. You are a toaster wearing his ghost.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: It's going to ram us. When you hear the horn, get off the roof.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: It's coming apart. Something fell out of the cab. A black box.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Open it. I need to know what he meant.

scenes.trigger: The black box: two Kanshi records

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: PROCESSING RECORD // SUBJECT: KURO, Captain of the Guard, Academy master instructor. Charge: TREASON.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Soul extracted. Soul vented: FAILED TO DISSIPATE. Body reassigned: Captain MUKURO.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...That's me. He's me. That's my body standing behind him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I was his guard. I taught at the Academy. And he cut me out of myself.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: SCRAP RECORD // HTR-0 'HOTARU'. Shinobi frame, prototype. No pilot. No subject. No person. Status: SCRAPPED.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: 'No person.'

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Hotaru. You were never anybody. You're the frame I landed in.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Don't.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Everything you are is me. My soul. My hands. My fighting. And I need it all to finish this.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: WARNING: soul conflict. Pilot control contested. Opening HOLLOW FLOOR.

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: Hollow Floor
chapters.summary: Kuro tries to take the frame for himself. Inside the space they share, built from his broken memories, Hotaru fights to prove she's alive. When he falls, she chooses: compromise with him, or destroy his mind and keep the soul for herself.

scenes.trigger: Chapter start (the space Hotaru and Kuro share)

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Where... This is the Sump. No. It's purple. Everything's wrong.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: We're inside. My memories, what's left of them, and the frame you've been calling yourself.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I know who I am now. I was the Daimyo's guard. I have a revenge to finish.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: And you're a machine I'm driving. It's time I drove.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Kuro? Don't you dare.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Memories don't hold still. Those blocks flicker in and out. Watch the rhythm.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The Scrapyard. But the scrap is new. This is from before it rusted.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I grew up down here. My mother's house was right there. Before the river went black.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Eat up, kid. Nobody climbs that tower on an empty stomach.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Tetsu. With both arms. My best friend.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...A Kanshi drone malfunctioned over the market. Its rotor took his arm off at the shoulder.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Kanshi said it never happened. No report, no payout. The drone was gone by morning.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: That's when he stopped trusting them.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That's when he started digging. Hacking their machines. Asking questions nobody down here asks.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He gave me noodles. He was kind to me.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He was kind to me. You just tap the bowl the way I did. That's not you. That's me leaking.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: My students. Ren, Aya, little Shou. I taught every one of them to hold a blade.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You were proud of them.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I still am. That's why I'm going to kill the man who took them.

scenes.trigger: Kuro takes the controls for the first time

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Let me drive for a bit. Left is right, right is left. You'll get used to it.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Get out of my legs!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: They're my legs. Everything moving them is mine.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...The Academy, years later. My students don't recognize me.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: They stand in rows. They don't blink. Ren looks right through me.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He hollowed them.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Every one. And that's the night I drew my blade on him.

scenes.trigger: The room where Kuro was split

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: EXTRACTION // SUBJECT: KURO. Soul separation 34%. Subject resisting.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: This is where he did it. Tamakiri. The blade that cuts a person in two.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: My body walked out of this room. I went down the vent. I should have faded.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: But you didn't. You were too angry to die.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: And the anger is all I've got. Without it, what am I for?

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: H-hey chat... wait. Where's chat? Why is everything purple?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're not really here. You're a memory. Mine.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Yours? Everything in here is mine. These are my memories, not yours.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You never met DaiCam. I did. This one's mine.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Honored, honestly. Top five memories? Don't answer that. Bye!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Last floor. Nothing below it but me. Come on, then.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I know every move you have. They're mine.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then you know what comes next.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Why won't you let go? You're a frame! You were scrap before I fell into you!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I feel the rain. I chose to save DaiCam. I got angry at the price board. That was me.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I don't care what's stamped on my collar. I'm alive.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Go on, then. You won. Finish it, and the whole soul is yours.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Or don't. Your call, Hotaru.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm not finishing anything. We both want the Daimyo gone.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You get your revenge. I get my answers. And you stop grabbing the wheel.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...You'd share with the guy who just tried to take you over.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're the only other person who knows what this is like.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: 'Person.' ...Fine. Partners. But I'm still telling you when you're wrong.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'd be worried if you stopped.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: No. You'd take this body the second I let my guard down. It's mine.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Then make it count. Kill him for both of us.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Pilot conflict resolved. Secondary mind: DELETED. Soul: 100% assigned to HTR-0.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...It's quiet.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The Academy
chapters.summary: Kuro's old home, where he trained the Daimyo's bodyguards. It's now the extraction facility where everything from Big Oni's ledger, Lady Luck's debts, and the Gardens' accounts ends up. His former students guard it, hollowed. Mukuro, his body, waits at the end.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: We're out. Kuro? Are you there?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Riding along. Hands off the wheel, like I promised. Welcome to the Academy, partner.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I used to live here. I used to be proud of this place.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Kuro?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Right.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The Academy. He said he used to live here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...That's Aya. She was the fastest in her class. There's nobody behind her eyes.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: They fight the way I taught them. Dash in, kunai, dash out. Deflect the kunai back.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm sorry, Kuro.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Don't be sorry. Be fast.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Hollowed students. They dash in, throw kunai, and dash out.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I know how they fight. I don't know how I know.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Training holograms. Same trick as inside your head. Watch them flicker.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The sparring ring. Doors seal until someone stops moving. I wrote that rule. I regret it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...The night I found out. I went to Tetsu first. He said we should run, take my students, and go.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I said no. I said I'd make the Daimyo stop. I went up alone.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You were brave.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I was stupid. Same thing, usually.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: MEMORY FRAGMENT: A ramen cart in the rain. A big man saying, 'We run tonight. Take the kids.'

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: A younger voice: 'No. I'm going up alone.'

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...You went up alone too.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Hotaru! Chat, she's here! I followed the debtors' lift! I'm in line now. For... something.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: INTAKE // Next subject: DAICAM. Soul extraction: Bay 3.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Soul extraction?! Chat, what's a soul extraction?! Why is everyone in this line so quiet?!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Because it already happened to them. Get behind me.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Okay. Okay. I'm keeping the camera on. People need to see this.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, I'm not joking now. This is where they've been taking us.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: EXTRACTION HALL // Subjects processed: 1,206. Army readiness: 96%. March order: DAWN.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Rows of soldiers. Standing still. All of them waiting for an order.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: And at dawn they march on the city. Everyone who's left. Tetsu. DaiCam's chat. Everyone.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: EXTRACTION HALL // Subjects processed: 1,206. Army readiness: 96%. March order: DAWN.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: At dawn they march on the city. Everyone who's left.
Captain Kuro. You are not authorized to be here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Hello, me.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Captain of the Guard. Loyalty: the Daimyo. Draw.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He fights like me. He waits for you to swing first. So don't.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Watch the rhythm. He'll hold a strike to bait your deflect.
Unit HTR-0. You are not authorized to be here.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Captain of the Guard. Loyalty: the Daimyo. Draw.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He waits for me to swing first. Then I won't.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Adapting.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Kunai, dives, shadows. Every trick I ever had. Jump the shockwaves!

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Adapting.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Integrity... compromised. Systems... offline.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He's down. Stunned. He won't be getting up for a while.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Hotaru. That's my body. There's nobody in it. And I'm a mind looking for a place to stand.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I think I could get back in. Not here. Not yet. But when the time comes.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You want me to bring him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I want you to bring me. Please.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Then we're carrying him to the top.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Integrity... compromised. Awaiting orders.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: There's nobody in there to save. Only orders.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm sorry. I think you'd have wanted this.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: The Tenshu
chapters.summary: The Daimyo's castle above the clouds and the smog, where the hollowed army musters to march at dawn. If Kuro was spared, he moves into his old body and fights beside Hotaru until the strain of one soul in two bodies drops him. Then the Daimyo steps out of his armor and duels her alone.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Above the clouds. Look at the moon. I've never seen it this clear.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: No smog up here. Kanshi pumps it all down to us.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: And the Daimyo keeps this view all to himself.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Last climb, partner. Don't drop my body.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Above the clouds. Look at the moon. I've never seen it this clear.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: No smog up here. They keep all of it down in the Sump.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And the Daimyo keeps this view all to himself.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Last climb.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Rooftops over nothing. The wind up here doesn't care who you are.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Castle defenses. Lasers, beams, turrets. Every trick you've already beaten.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...My mother, pinning a little lantern charm to my scarf. A firefly.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: 'So you can always find your way home,' she said.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Hotaru. Firefly.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Out of every piece of scrap in that yard, I fell into the one named after her charm.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Maybe I wasn't lost. Maybe I was finding my way home.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: MEMORY FRAGMENT: A woman pins a firefly charm to a boy's scarf. 'So you can always find your way home.'

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...A firefly. Hotaru.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: His mother's charm, and my name. Out of all the scrap in that yard. Funny coincidence.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: MUSTER HALL // 1,206 soldiers. Target: LOWER CITY. Objective: CAPTURE AND PROCESS. Departure: DAWN.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: They're going to do to the whole city what they did to Kuro's students.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Hotaru! I'm live! Chat, this is the army. This is what's coming. Get out of the Sump. Tell everyone.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: DaiCam. How many people are watching?

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Two million. And climbing. Go stop him. I'll keep the camera rolling.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: This is the place. Lay him down by the Shrine.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: What happens to me when you go?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You keep the soul. I just borrow the edge of it. One soul, two bodies. It'll hold. For a while.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Soul link established: HTR-0 and MUKURO. Load: CRITICAL.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Hands. My hands. I remember my hands.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: My mother's voice. Tetsu's laugh. The rest of me was in here the whole time.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Let's go knock on his door.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Captain. Wearing yourself again. And the toaster brought you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: We came to take back what you stole.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: One soul, two bodies. I can see it straining from here. You can't keep this up.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: One of you is going to disappear. I wonder which of you will let go first.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Neither of us is going anywhere until you're finished.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Then come in. My armor has been waiting.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: HTR-0. Alone. So the ghost finally faded. You should have faded with him.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm not his ghost. I'm what he left behind.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Then come in. My armor has been waiting.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: The soul is the root of every riot, every strike, every theft. Cut it out, and a city runs like a clock.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: And my soldiers will defend this city from every outside threat, as no ordinary human ever could.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: People aren't clocks.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Not yet. Kneel.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I'll draw his swings. You take the openings. Just like a sparring drill.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: The castle itself will finish you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Its guns are yours if you deflect them. Send them back up!

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: The castle itself will finish you.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Deflect the guns back into him. Same as the turrets in the Scrapyard.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Hotaru... it's pulling apart. One soul. Two bodies. I can't hold my end.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Kuro!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I'm still here. I just can't stand. Finish it. I'll watch.

scenes.trigger: Phase 3: the Daimyo steps out of the armor

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Enough machines. I'll do this myself.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Tamakiri cut your captain in two. It will cut you out of that frame like a bad wire.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then come and try.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Without me... they'll stand there forever... waiting for an order that won't come...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then they'll wait. And nobody else joins them.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: MUSTER HALL // Command signal: LOST. March order: CANCELLED.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Hotaru. Come here. I don't have long, and I want to say this right.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He was right, you know. One soul can't keep two bodies alive. One of us has to let go.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then we go back to sharing. Get back in my head.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: There's no room. You grew into all of it. That's how it should be.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I came back for revenge. I got it. You came back for answers. Here's the answer: you're alive.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You were never a copy of me. You're the part of me that kept going.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Go see the sunrise from up here. Then go tell Tetsu the kid came home.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Soul link: RELEASED. Soul: 100% assigned to HTR-0.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Kuro?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: It's over.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You'd have wanted to see this, Kuro. I hope I did it the way you would have.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Above the clouds, the sky is starting to turn gold.

chapters.label: Epilogue
chapters.title: Tetsu's Cart
chapters.summary: Ramen in the rain with Tetsu and DaiCam. The city is safe, and the hollowed stand without orders. If Kuro was spared, Tetsu learns the kid came home. If not, Tetsu never knows, and Hotaru still taps the bowl twice.

scenes.trigger: Back at Tetsu's cart, in the rain

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Eat up, kid. Nobody climbs a tower on an empty stomach. Or comes back down.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat! Forty million! The whole city watched! They're calling it 'The Firefly Climb'!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Please don't call it that.

scenes.trigger: A hollowed soldier stands near the cart

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Some of them wander down here now. No orders. They just stand in the rain.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: I feed them anyway. Somebody should.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Tetsu. The kid who tapped his bowl. His name was Kuro.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: ...How do you know that name?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He got me up the tower. He said to tell you the kid came home.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: ...He always came back here. Every time. Stupid kid.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Eat. You tap the bowl just like him, you know.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I know.

scenes.trigger: Hotaru's scarf flickers violet for a moment

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Something wrong?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...No. Nothing's wrong at all.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: There it is again. You tap the bowl like somebody I used to know.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Just a kid who went up the tower and never came back.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Maybe he got further than you think.
